p0_gap_1.name: Governance Guard Rule 2 is DL-029 vulnerable
p0_gap_1.detail: The governance guard was upgraded from FM-001 (±1200 char forward-scan regex) to AM-2-style (string-aware object-bounded extraction). This eliminates the three most critical vulnerability classes (fixed window, cross-object CC contamination, string-unawareness). However, the implementation is NOT AM-1 (Function Constructor Parse on full file). Key AM-1 capabilities still missing: (1) full-file pre/post diff to distinguish new violations from pre-existing, (2) QID-level violation reporting, (3) Pack B gold-standard compliance test with real files. The guard still operates on change-text only and does not read from disk.
p0_gap_1.recommendation: Accept the current AM-2-style implementation as a P0 interim fix (it eliminates the proven DL-029 failure modes). Schedule AM-1 full-file parse upgrade for S727 or S728 as initially planned. The AM-2 approach is sufficient for P0 because it eliminates cross-object contamination and fixed-window truncation — the two documented failure modes that produced 885+ false positives historically.

p0_gap_2.name: Transfer→Accept→Approve→Close lacks enforcement gate
p0_gap_2.s725_source: S723→S724 ownership gap (6 gaps discovered post-closure)
p0_gap_2.detail: Agent H's Series Closure Gate v1.0 (773 lines) defines a complete, comprehensive gate specification. The design would have blocked S723 (12/12 checklist items would have failed). However: (1) Rule 6 is proposed as WARN, not BLOCK; (2) the rule has NOT been implemented in governance-guard.js; (3) the gate is procedurally dependent on Governance Auditor diligence; (4) key steps (genuineness of acceptance, board approval authenticity) cannot be mechanically verified.
p0_gap_2.recommendation: Accept the procedural gate as valid for current governance maturity. Implement Rule 6 as WARN (as designed) in governance-guard.js for session S727. Add to AGENTS.md §9 the closure governance section proposed by Agent H. Acknowledge that mechanical BLOCK of closure is infeasible — the procedural + plugin-WARN + board-escalation tiered model is the correct architecture.
